# BMP 1.1.0

New in this update:

- process-wide parser/decode security limits with sane defaults
- runtime version number API (`bmp_version_number`)
- human-readable error descriptions (`bmp_error_description`)
- decoded RGBA buffer size helper (`bmp_calc_rgba32_buffer_size`)
- install / uninstall / pkg-config support
- SECURITY.md documenting operational hardening
